Features: (1) Two MG996R shoulder servo pockets on {x=0, z=290}: case volumes y 10 to 48 (L) and -48 to -10 (R), 40.7 mm along X (x -30.7 to +10.0), 19.7 mm along Z (z 280.2-299.8), 0.5 mm air per side, opening AFT (-X) so each servo drops in; per servo 4x M4 self-tapper holes in Ø5.5 bosses on the 49.5 x 10.0 lug pattern; an 8 x 4 mm wire slot at each pocket's inboard-low corner. (2) Two hip servo pockets on {x=0, z=180}: cases y 1 to 39 (L) / -39 to -1 (R), same X/Z orientation (z 170.2-189.8), opening UP (+Z), same lug bosses and 0.5 air; Ø8 wire grommet holes through the pelvis top deck at (-15, +20, 192) and (-15, -20, 192), 0.5 mm lead-in chamfer both entries, with a Ø4 zip-tie boss beside each. (3) Shoulder bearing bosses: Ø34 annular bosses on each flank about the +Y axis through (0, +/-71, 290): outer face at |y|=60, Ø20.4 bore land |y| 55.0-60.0 (5 mm), Ø26 x 5 horn-clearance counterbore |y| 50.0-55.0, 0.5 lead-in both bore entries (running fit 0.40 over the arm pod's Ø20.0 journal). (4) Hip bearing bosses on the pelvis flanks about the +Y axis through (0, +/-40, 180): Ø34 OD spanning |y| 42.0-51.0, Ø26 counterbore |y| 42.0-46.0, Ø20.4 bore land |y| 46.0-51.0, 0.5 lead-ins. (5) Neck stub on top: Ø8.0 journal, 6 mm land z 299-305, 0.5 lead-in at tip, e-clip groove 0.9 wide x 0.6 deep (root Ø6.8) at z 305.0-305.9. (6) Perimeter tongue lips 1.2 wide x 1.5 deep around the front chest opening (+X, z 200-298) and the rear service opening over the electronics bay (z 200-260), each with 4x Ø4.5 M3 screw bosses (Ø2.5 pilot, 0.5 lead-in). (7) 6 mm half-round wire channels molded down the inner side walls from both shoulder pockets and up from both hip grommets to the bay. PLA, print upright, minimal support.

assembly_note: All parts are authored in one shared frame (Z up from the sole, X forward, Y left) and overlay at the origin: servos drop into torso-frame pockets (aft-opening shoulders, top-opening hips), each limb pod's Ø20 journal rides its torso/pelvis Ø20.4 boss and screws to the MG996R horn, elbow/knee pins press into tongues and run in clevis bores retained by press-on domed caps, the head drops onto the Ø8 neck stub and is retained by the snap-on C-clip, and chest/back/visor/foot plates screw onto their tongue-and-groove seats.
